definition: In this context, delivery means the transport of antigens or other cell contents into another cell by extracellular vesicles. It refers to those vesicles carrying material to dendritic cells so it can be taken up and later presented to activate immune responses.

reasons: The requested field is not supported: the packet is about extracellular vesicle uptake and antigen presentation in dendritic cells, not cognition/psychology.
